# coin.im

The homepage at https://coin.im/ offers 10,000 business letters for $30,000, or $3 per letter. Includes business research, Market Scan, recipient selection, sales copy, physical grabbers, printing, packaging, delivery and reporting. Coverage: New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Austin, Miami, San Diego, Denver, Boston, Seattle and Atlanta.

The paid three-slot message wall has moved to https://coin.im/message . Existing checkout, receipts, archive, stats, rules and market API routes remain in place. The market database is independent of direct-mail campaigns.

Market Scan development story: https://coin.im/ms
Original direct-mail page: https://coin.im/mail
Manual encrypted business-file intake: https://coin.im/open
Contact: mail@coin.im

The direct-mail intake does not provide a self-service customer dashboard. Reporting access is arranged with the team before dispatch.
